svg.text: u_0 = p, v_0 = Delta_X, r_0 = 0, s_0 = Delta_Y = Y_2 - Y_1 (mod p)

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Standard ECDLP computes Delta_X^{-1} mod p first, then multiplies by Delta_Y (extra 256Q).

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Seeding s_0 = Delta_Y directly into |VS⟩ maintains the linear invariant mod p:

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Mono', 'CMU Typewriter Text', 'JetBrains Mono', 'Courier New', monospace

svg.text: r_t * Delta_X equiv u_t * Delta_Y (mod p), s_t * Delta_X equiv v_t * Delta_Y (mod p)

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • At step t = 2N = 512 (when v_{2N} = 0 and u_{2N} = gcd(p, Delta_X) = 1):

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: r_{2N} equiv Delta_Y * Delta_X^{-1} equiv lambda (mod p) Directly inside |UR[0..255]⟩!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Saves both the 512-qubit (r,s) registers AND the 256-qubit slope multiplication scratchpad.

svg.text: • Key Insight: J = 16 consecutive divsteps depend ONLY on the lowest 2J = 32 bits of (u, v)!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Phase A (Local Focus): Execute 16 divsteps inside the 32-bit focus register while accumulating

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: the 2x2 transition matrix M_window = [[f_00, f_01], [f_10, f_11]] with |f_ij| ≤ 2^16.

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Phase B (Full-Width Sweep): Apply M_window across the 16 limbs of UR and VS in a single

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: zipper pass, reducing full-width 256-bit additions from 512 steps down to M = 32 windows!

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: • Pebble Footprint: Only 1 bit per divstep (16 bits per window) is needed to invert a window;

text.font-family: 'Latin Modern Roman', 'CMU Serif', 'STIX Two Text', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

svg.text: s = 4 binomial pebbles * 16 bits = 64 Q total pebble memory (vs. 512 Q full history log!).
